integrity: The continuum argument is self-contained modulo standard Cauchy projection and spherical cap formulas; exact rational cone enumeration and independent projected-hull comparisons corroborate essential finite identities. scientific_limitations: Haar-uniform three-volume projections of the regular four-dimensional cross-polytope only; the exact upper law holds on an explicit endpoint interval and the lower law is asymptotic with order-four remainder. The full brightness distribution and higher-dimensional extensions are not claimed. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp brightness endpoint law and cuboctahedral tangent geometry for the four-dimensional cross-polytope
